responsibility: Defines the M32C backend’s data-movement and conversion patterns: register/memory/control-register moves, far-memory loads and stores, push/pop forms, mode extensions and truncations, reload helpers, and peepholes that fold address arithmetic or combine adjacent stores. It is the primary source of RTL patterns for moving scalar and pointer values across the backend’s mixed register, memory, and control-register classes, including PSI-specific split logic for 24-bit pointers.
